rules.new_licensee_rule: APRNs who graduated from an accredited master's or higher APRN program within the last two years are exempt for the first renewal of State Certification only.
rules.audit_note: Periodic audits; documents due within 10 business days of notice.
rules.notes: 5 contact hours directly related to controlled substances per State Certification Period (Jan 1 of the odd year to Dec 31 of the even year), for all APRNs regardless of prescriptive authority. Certificates (PDF) uploaded to CE Broker. RNs have no general CE.
